title: Fix percentile grammar (30.3th → 30.3rd)
prompt: Find the percentile formatting function in the MERIT frontend. Fix it so numbers use correct ordinals: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th... 11th, 12th, 13th... 21st, 22nd, 23rd. 30.3 should render as '30.3rd'. Test by rendering the component.

title: Add Program Expense Ratio to snapshot
prompt: In the Financial Snapshot section, add a new row 'Program Expense Ratio' calculated as (program_service_expenses / total_expenses) * 100. Show as percentage with 0 decimals. Add helper text: 'How much goes to programs vs overhead'. Use data already passed to the component.

title: Add Revenue Trend (3yr)
prompt: Add 'Revenue Trend (3yr)' to Financial Snapshot. Calculate ((current_revenue - revenue_3yr_ago) / revenue_3yr_ago) * 100. Display as ↗ +12% (green), ↘ -5% (red), or → 0% (gray). Handle divide-by-zero gracefully.

title: Add Impact Data Not Available section
prompt: Create a new component ImpactGapSection.jsx. It should display: 'We don't have structured MERIT data for this organization yet. The IRS 990 does not require standardized outcome reporting.' Then list 3 questions donors can ask the org. Style as a light blue/gray info box. Import and render it below FinancialSnapshot on the profile page.

title: Add Verify This Data / Missing Data footers
prompt: At the bottom of the profile page, add two sections: 1) 'Verify This Data' with external links (IRS search, Form 990 PDF, state registration). 2) 'What We Don't Know' listing missing data points: MERIT metrics, board minutes, staff demographics, volunteer hours. Keep styling neutral and compact.
